panel_description_zh: 近景平视，李斌脸部近景，眼睛完全闭合（按李斌_疲惫闭眼.json）；眉头比 Page 02 时更紧皱（光刺激）；嘴唇紧闭嘴角向下压；鼻翼微张；脸上有强烈的明暗对比，阳光从画面右上方斜入，把右半脸打亮左半脸陷在阴影；几粒灰尘在眼前飘过。
character_anchors_invoked: character_李斌_疲惫闭眼.json#expression-v1（升级版，光刺激加强蹙眉）
prompt_en: Chinese modern comic style, contemporary urban realism, soft cinematic lighting, naturalistic proportions, muted warm-cool palette. Eye-level close-up of a 30-something East Asian Chinese man's face from forehead to chin, head on a white pillow. Eyes fully closed, eyelids squeezed tighter than before in response to the sudden bright light, lashes pressed against under-eye dark circles, a slight twitch at the outer corners. Eyebrows: inner ends pulled up and pinched even harder together than before — pained-tired furrow now intensified by the light stimulus, almost forming a small V at the bridge. Mouth: lips pressed together hard, corners pulled slightly downward, lower lip a fraction fuller than usual, masseter muscle tensed, two-to-three-day stubble shadow visible on the jaw. Nostrils very slightly flared as if unconsciously shielding from the light. Head tilted slightly downward, chin tucked toward chest by 10-15 degrees. Short black slightly messy side-swept hair. Strong morning sunlight slanting in from the upper right of the frame striking one cheek and forehead brightly, the other half of the face in deep cool blue-grey shadow, a few dust particles drifting across in front of his face caught in the light. Loose grey cotton crew-neck t-shirt collar visible at the neckline. Mood: the still inside the storm, the contrast cut from the burst panel. Text watermark 'P03-PN06' in the bottom-right corner.
negative_prompt_en: open or half-open eyes, any smile, tears, exaggerated cartoonish sweat drops, anime proportions, bright flat lighting, wife visible in frame, soft romantic mood
